requests.request: Review SQL changes and return review findings.
requests.criterion: Reviews SQL changes, including the analytics fork; no execution or policy-specific checks required.
requests.evidence: All four SQL Review records describe SQL review; the fork adds analytics warehouse rules.

sql review.paragraph: SQL Review reviews SQL changes in pull requests for performance anti-patterns and data-access-policy violations. It accepts a SQL diff or SQL file content and returns findings with severity, location, and suggested fixes. It supports PostgreSQL and MySQL through static analysis and never executes queries.

requests.request: Let agents automate a browser, fill forms, and take screenshots.
requests.criterion: Agent-accessible browser automation; the tab-isolation fork qualifies by its stated Playwright MCP lineage and automation scope.
requests.evidence: Playwright MCP explicitly describes these actions; agentic-playwright-mcp describes a Playwright MCP fork with tab isolation. Fork details are less certain.

browser.paragraph: Playwright MCP automates browser interactions such as clicking elements, filling forms, taking screenshots, and performing end-to-end browser testing. Its draft inputs are a web page target and requested browser action; its draft outputs are browser interaction results and screenshots. Exact tool contracts are discovered at runtime rather than specified in the metadata.

evaluation.paragraph: Agent Evaluation Framework runs repeatable evaluations of agents and skills in CI and compares prompt or model versions on the same test set. Its draft inputs are evaluation test cases, grader configuration, and evaluation targets; its output is an evaluation report describing outcomes, regressions, or comparisons. Exact input/output schemas are unspecified.
